_about: Catalogue of the laws, rules and regulations administered by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, built from a search engine's index of SECP's website on 1 November 2026 (SECP blocks automated access, so its pages were not opened) and from documents the user saved. Titles, S.R.O. numbers and edition dates are as shown in SECP's listing titles or the saved documents and are to be confirmed. `library` names the instrument's id when its text is in the library; `register` names the Act whose register records it; `saved` means a PDF is in the user's OneDrive folder. Not a complete list yet: directives, circulars, guidelines and orders are not covered.
